#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
LOG_TS() { date +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"; } log() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] INFO $*" >&2; } warn() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] WARN $*" >&2; } error() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] ERROR $*" >&2; }
cleanup() { local rc=$? local cmd="${BASH_COMMAND:-}" local line="${BASH_LINENO[0]:-}"
if [[ $rc -eq 0 ]]; then log "EXIT rc=0 (success). Cleaning AWS env vars." else error "EXIT rc=${rc} at line=${line} cmd=${cmd}. Cleaning AWS env vars." fi
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN } on_err() { local rc=$? local line="${BASH_LINENO[0]:-}" local cmd="${BASH_COMMAND:-}" error "ERR rc=${rc} at line=${line} cmd=${cmd}" return "$rc" } trap on_err ERR trap cleanup EXIT
need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { error "Missing required command: $1"; exit 2; }; }
assume_role() { local role_arn="${ROLE_ARN:-arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl}" local session_name="${ROLE_SESSION_NAME:-s3-test}" local duration="${ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS:-3600}"
log "Assuming role ${role_arn} (duration=${duration}s)" local assume_json assume_json="$(mktemp)"
aws sts assume-role \ --duration-seconds "$duration" \ --role-arn "$role_arn" \ --role-session-name "$session_name" \ > "$assume_json"
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$(jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId' "$assume_json")" AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey' "$assume_json")" AWS_SESSION_TOKEN="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken' "$assume_json")" rm -f "$assume_json"
log "Role assumed" }
reset_dir() { rm -rf "$1"; mkdir -p "$1"; }
wait_all() { local pids=("$@") local rc=0 pid for pid in "${pids[@]}"; do if ! wait "$pid"; then rc=1 warn "Background job failed (pid=$pid)" fi done return "$rc" }
# Split CSV bytes into ~N-byte chunks WITHOUT breaking records and WITHOUT rewriting CSV. # - Preserves original bytes exactly (no re-quoting, no header injection). # - Splits only at newline that occurs outside of quoted fields. split_csv_record_safe_bytes() { local infile="$1" outprefix="$2" target_bytes="${3:-250000000}"
python3 - "$infile" "$outprefix" "$target_bytes" <<'PY' import os, sys
infile, outprefix, target = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], int(sys.argv[3]) if target <= 0: raise SystemExit("target_bytes must be > 0")
bufsize = 1024 * 1024 # 1 MiB
part = 0 written = 0 in_quotes = False quote_pending = False # saw a quote while in_quotes; need next byte to decide escape vs close
def part_path(i: int) -> str: return f"{outprefix}.{i:04d}"
out = open(part_path(part), "wb")
def rotate(): global part, out, written out.flush() out.close() part += 1 out = open(part_path(part), "wb") written = 0
with open(infile, "rb") as f: while True: data = f.read(bufsize) if not data: break
i = 0 n = len(data) while i < n: b = data[i:i+1] i += 1
# Resolve pending quote decision (escape "" vs closing ") if quote_pending: if b == b'"': # Escaped quote inside quoted field: write it and stay in_quotes out.write(b) written += 1 quote_pending = False continue else: # Previous quote closed the quoted field; process current byte normally in_quotes = False quote_pending = False # fall through
if b == b'"': out.write(b) written += 1 if in_quotes: quote_pending = True else: in_quotes = True continue
out.write(b) written += 1
# Record boundary: newline outside quotes if b == b"\n" and (not in_quotes) and (not quote_pending): if written >= target: rotate()
out.flush() out.close()
# Remove trailing empty part if created last = part_path(part) if os.path.exists(last) and os.path.getsize(last) == 0: os.remove(last) PY }
# ----------------------------- # Prereqs + required inputs # ----------------------------- need aws need jq need csvcut need csvformat need tail need java need python3
: "${managed_inputs:?managed_inputs must be set (s3://.../Managed_Inputs.csv)}"
S3_BUCKET="${S3_BUCKET:-avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl}" CHUNK_BYTES="${CHUNK_BYTES:-250000000}" # ~250MB HEAP_GB="${HEAP_GB:-64}" PARALLEL="${PARALLEL:-16}"
# ----------------------------- # Workspace # ----------------------------- reset_dir beforeRemoval reset_dir data reset_dir completed reset_dir processing
# ----------------------------- # Auth once # ----------------------------- assume_role
# ----------------------------- # Inputs # ----------------------------- log "Downloading managed inputs: ${managed_inputs}" aws s3 cp "$managed_inputs" ./Managed_Inputs.csv --no-progress --only-show-errors
log "Downloading metadata_new_search.json" aws s3 cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/data/metadata_new_search.json" ./metadata_new_search.json --no-progress --only-show-errors
log "Creating inputs.csv" csvcut -c "Study Abbreviated Name","Study Identifier","Study Type","Data is ready to process","Data Processed" \ Managed_Inputs.csv > inputs.csv # ----------------------------- # Download per study (record-safe, byte-preserving, no header injection) # ----------------------------- download() { local abv_name="$1" stdy_id="$2" local abv_lc stdy_lc abv_lc="$(printf '%s' "$abv_name" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" stdy_lc="$(printf '%s' "$stdy_id" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
local s3_src="s3://${S3_BUCKET}/${abv_lc}/completed/${stdy_id}/${stdy_lc}_allConcepts_new_search_with_data_analyzer.csv" local dst="beforeRemoval/${stdy_lc}_allConcepts_new_search_with_data_analyzer.csv"
log "Downloading ${stdy_id} allConcepts" aws s3 cp "$s3_src" "$dst" --no-progress --only-show-errors
}
# ----------------------------- # Download + split per study (record-safe, byte-preserving, no header injection) # ----------------------------- download_and_split() { local abv_name="$1" stdy_id="$2" local abv_lc stdy_lc abv_lc="$(printf '%s' "$abv_name" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" stdy_lc="$(printf '%s' "$stdy_id" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
local s3_src="s3://${S3_BUCKET}/${abv_lc}/completed/${stdy_id}/${stdy_lc}_allConcepts_new_search_with_data_analyzer.csv" local dst="beforeRemoval/${stdy_lc}_allConcepts_new_search_with_data_analyzer.csv"
log "Downloading ${stdy_id} allConcepts" aws s3 cp "$s3_src" "$dst" --no-progress --only-show-errors
if [[ ! -s "$dst" ]]; then error "Downloaded file missing/empty for ready study ${abv_name} ${stdy_id}: ${dst}" return 255 fi
log "Record-safe splitting ${stdy_id} (target_bytes=${CHUNK_BYTES})" split_csv_record_safe_bytes "$dst" "$dst" "$CHUNK_BYTES" rm -f "$dst"
log "Downloaded and split ${stdy_id}" }
while IFS=',' read -r abv_name stdy_id stdy_type data_ready data_processed; do abv_name="${abv_name%\"}"; abv_name="${abv_name#\"}" stdy_id="${stdy_id%\"}"; stdy_id="${stdy_id#\"}" data_ready="${data_ready%\"}"; data_ready="${data_ready#\"}"
if [[ "${data_ready,,}" == "yes" ]]; then download "$abv_name" "$stdy_id" else log "${abv_name} ${stdy_id} marked not ready; skipping" fi done < <(tail -n +2 inputs.csv | csvformat -U 1)
# ----------------------------- # Download shared inputs (parallel OK) # ----------------------------- pids=()
log "Downloading HRMN_allConcepts.csv" aws s3 cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/hrmn/completed/HRMN_allConcepts.csv" \ "beforeRemoval/HRMN_allConcepts.csv" --no-progress --only-show-errors & pids+=("$!")
log "Downloading GLOBAL_allConcepts_merged.csv" aws s3 cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/completed/GLOBAL_allConcepts_merged.csv" \ "beforeRemoval/GLOBAL_allConcepts.csv" --no-progress --only-show-errors & pids+=("$!")
log "Waiting for shared downloads..." wait_all "${pids[@]}"
# ----------------------------- # Run jars # ----------------------------- log "Running RemoveConsentZeroPatients.jar" java -Xms32g -Xmx"${HEAP_GB}g" \ -DmaximumPoolSize="$PARALLEL" \ -Djava.util.concurrent.ForkJoinPool.common.parallelism="$PARALLEL" \ -XX:+ExitOnOutOfMemoryError \ -XX:+HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError \ -XX:HeapDumpPath=./oom-heapdump.hprof \ -Xlog:gc*,safepoint:file=gc.log:time,level,tags \ -jar jars/RemoveConsentZeroPatients.jar
log "Running DbGapDataMerge.jar" java -Xmx"${HEAP_GB}g" -jar jars/DbGapDataMerge.jar
# ----------------------------- # Upload output # ----------------------------- unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
assume_role log "Uploading result to s3" aws s3 cp "completed/allConcepts.csv" \ "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/completed/allConcepts_data_analyzer.csv" \ --no-progress --only-show-errors
log "Done"
